8.38.1. iLock_Geography.type_manager.TypeManager¶

class iLock_Geography.type_manager.TypeManager(railyard)¶

A type manager constructs the base types and compound types for the railyard components of a railyard.

It provides a number of convenience functions for accessing the railyard components’ base types, compound types and user types.

Methods

__init__(railyard) Constructor.
dumpUserType2BaseType() Print the content of the map from user types to base types.
getAllTypes() Return an iterator object that iterates all type objects.
getBaseType(userTypeName) Return the base type object for the name of user type.
getType(typeName) Return the type object for typeName.
isNameTree(nameTree) A membership function that tests if all name(s) in nameTree have the corresponding railyard objects in the considered railyard.
nameTree2ryObjectTree(nameTree) Return the railyard objects that correspond to the name(s) in nameTree.
railyard() Return the railyard object.
